verdict.rationale: PostHog documents feature-flag tool categories (27 tools) in its MCP server, explicit examples of agents shipping/targeting flags from a prompt ('ship a feature flag from a prompt', '@PostHog add a feature flag ... roll it out to everyone with an @example.com email'), and API access for flags via personal API keys/OAuth scopes plus the CLI. The MCP server is a live, OAuth-gated hosted endpoint confirmed by probe evidence. missing for 10: no explicit hands-on transcript showing an agent toggling an existing flag on/off via MCP, and no independent third-party verification of flag-specific MCP tool behavior.
